fields.name: envSlug
fields.description: Owning environment slug — canonical (dev/stg/prod/uat) or per-project custom env slug. Required for new records (the app layer stamps it on every create); legacy records predating the env-scoped refactor may be empty.

fields.name: clonedFromFeatureId
fields.description: ItemId of the dev feature this record was cloned from. Stamped on insert by useCloneFlow when it auto-creates the destination feature. The cross-env sync feature (delete + rename) looks up sibling features via this field — records with no value are pre-existing clones that don't participate in cascade sync.

fields.name: developerIds
fields.description: OIDC `sub`s of users assigned to develop this feature. Empty array (or omitted) means unassigned. A feature can be co-developed by any number of developers. Per-env, not propagated to cloned siblings in other envs. Replaces the single-value `developerId` field.

fields.name: qaIds
fields.description: OIDC `sub`s of users assigned to QA this feature. Empty array (or omitted) means unassigned. A feature can be co-tested by any number of QAs. Per-env, not propagated to cloned siblings in other envs. The QA dropdown is populated from users with the `tester` IAM role. Replaces the single-value `qaId` field.

fields.name: githubLink
fields.description: Optional GitHub URL (issue, PR, or repo path) associated with this feature — e.g. https://github.com/owner/repo/issues/123. Free-form string; no validation enforced at the data layer (UI may prefix `https://` if the user omits the scheme).
